clips.title: The story
paras: Across the southern Barrens, Verog the Dervish keeps moving, and Regthar Deathgate seeks to draw him out. The orc directs Horde champions to attack the Kolkar command tent at the Stagnant Oasis, hoping to force the nomadic leader into the open.

After Barak Kodobane fell, Regthar Deathgate turned to the remaining Kolkar warlords. Barak had stayed near the northern waters of the Forgotten Pools, but Verog the Dervish roams the sun-baked plains and rarely lingers in one camp. Horde scouts cannot easily track him across that wide territory. Their chance is to make the commander come to them.

Verog operates from the Kolkar command post at the Stagnant Oasis, southeast of the Crossroads. Regthar sends you against the camp, where you strike the Kolkar warriors near their command tent. Their alarm calls Verog back to defend the outpost, bringing him within reach of the Horde blades.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The centaur Verog the Dervish wanders the Barrens, and will be difficult to find. But he is based at the centaur command tent at the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast. It may be possible to draw him to you.
Travel to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast and attack centaur near the command tent. It will be dangerous, but if you can kill enough centaur then they should raise an alarm. And Verog will come.
Bring me his head and I will place it with Barak Kodobane's.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good. You must have really stirred up those centaur -- our guards spotted activity down near the Stagnant Oasis, which was probably you.
You should be proud of your deed, friend. There is much bravery in you.
